repairs.quote: Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for 1 second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for 4 seconds. The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing 40/45/50/55/60% of normal damage. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or true sight.
